nodes.v: Call now and we will book you on this call.
Waiting for our callback is perfectly fine. But if you would rather have a time locked in right now — or something is hurting — calling is the fastest route to an appointment.

<style>*{box-sizing:border-box}*::before{box-sizing:border-box}*::after{box-sizing:border-box}</style><script data-embed="">
  /* Open/closed indicator — conversion layer, runs without GSAP.
     CLIENT-SPECIFIC BLOCK: the HOURS table is the practice's own; Grand
     Mission's hours differ. Guarded so the section stays movable. */
  (function () {
    "use strict";
    var stateEl = document.querySelector("[data-open-state]");
    var dotEl = document.querySelector("[data-open-dot]");
    if (!stateEl && !dotEl) return;
    var HOURS = [
      null,                                  // Sunday
      { open: [9, 0], close: [18, 0] },      // Monday
      { open: [8, 0], close: [17, 0] },      // Tuesday
      { open: [9, 0], close: [18, 0] },      // Wednesday
      { open: [8, 0], close: [17, 0] },      // Thursday
      null,                                  // Friday
      null,                                  // Saturday
    ];
    var NAMES = ["Sunday", "Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday", "Friday", "Saturday"];
    function fmt(hm) {
      var h = hm[0], m = hm[1];
      var ap = h >= 12 ? "pm" : "am";
      var hh = h % 12 || 12;
      return hh + (m ? ":" + String(m).padStart(2, "0") : ":00") + " " + ap;
    }
    var now = new Date();
    var today = HOURS[now.getDay()];
    var mins = now.getHours() * 60 + now.getMinutes();
    var isOpen =
      !!today &&
      mins >= today.open[0] * 60 + today.open[1] &&
      mins < today.close[0] * 60 + today.close[1];
    if (stateEl) {
      if (isOpen) {
        stateEl.textContent = "Open now until " + fmt(today.close);
      } else if (today) {
        stateEl.textContent =
          mins < today.open[0] * 60
            ? "Opens today at " + fmt(today.open)
            : "Closed for today — opens tomorrow";
      } else {
        for (var i = 1; i <= 7; i++) {
          var d = (now.getDay() + i) % 7;
          if (HOURS[d]) {
            stateEl.textContent =
              "Closed today — opens " + (i === 1 ? "tomorrow" : NAMES[d]) + " at " + fmt(HOURS[d].open);
            break;
          }
        }
      }
    }
    if (dotEl && isOpen) dotEl.classList.add("is-open");
  })();
  </script>
